quantifier: Under Assumption 4.1 and each model's conditions, all three model classes obey the same Wasserstein and projection-tail orders for sufficiently small alpha.
assumptions: stationary uniformly ergodic exogenous Markov chain
centered bounded noise and positive-definite absolutely convergent long-run covariance
bounded solutions to both finite-state Poisson equations
operationalization: Product of eight stationary two-state refresh chains with rho=0.55, bounded skew output, and analytic long-run covariance (1+rho)/(1-rho).
acceptance: SGD, linear, and contractive models each pass held-out W1 paper-rate envelopes.
Markov projection tails pass the held-out alpha^(1/4)sqrt(log)/a envelope.
The iid covariance substituted for long-run covariance is retained as a negative control.
